rules.rule: docs/tier4_orchestration_state/msca_dn/esr/msca-dn-2025-original-esr.json is the ESR record for the V14 compare. rules.rule: The runbook's compare line names the successor. The private V14 dispositions bind the successor's sha256 in esr_record_sha256. The approved public dispositions remain the template for rows only, because they bind the predecessor's sha256.
